@da-facility.sidebarLayout.navigation.description: Default accessible name for the navigation, and its title in the sidebar.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.open.description: Floating menu button on phones. {label} is the navigation name in lowercase.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.close.description: Button that closes the navigation drawer on phones.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.leftHanded.description: Switch that moves the menu button and drawer to the left edge.

@da-facility.userMenu.label.description: Accessible name of the account button. {name} is the person’s name.

@da-facility.projectSelector.label.description: Default heading of the project menu and its accessible name.

@da-facility.projectSelector.trigger.description: Accessible name of the project button, such as “Projects: Web app”.

@da-facility.projectSelector.noneSelecte.description: Shown on the project button when no project is selected.

@da-facility.projectSelector.searchLabel.description: Accessible name of the search field. {label} is the menu heading in lowercase.

@da-facility.projectSelector.searchPlace.description: Placeholder of the compact search field.

@da-facility.projectSelector.clearSearch.description: Button that empties the search field.

@da-facility.projectSelector.noMatches.description: Shown when the search finds nothing.

@da-facility.projectSelector.create.description: Action at the end of the project menu.

@da-facility.loginSplit.title.description: Default heading of the sign-in form.

@da-facility.loginSplit.error.defaultMessage: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
@da-facility.loginSplit.error.description: Shown when sign-in fails without a message of its own.

@da-facility.assistant.label.description: Label of the chat bar and title of the open chat.

@da-facility.assistant.placeholder.defaultMessage: What can I do for you today?

@da-facility.assistant.suggestions.description: Accessible name of the list of starter prompts.

@da-facility.assistant.context.description: Accessible name of the tag showing what the assistant can see.
